n: [Doujinshi] [CHARAN PORAN (Nekono Matatabi)] Konna Futanari na Kusuri ga Aru nara Tsukau Shikanai ja Arimasen ka | 既然有这么棒的扶她药 除了拿来用之外根本别无选择吧 (Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete) [Chinese] [古式雨个人汉化] [Digital]
